description: Search UAE merchants with live discounts on Discond by free text, place (emirate or area such as "Dubai Marina"), coordinates, discount provider, or category. Returns merchants with links; when the user is signed in to Discond it also returns their best current offers.

category.description: One of Discond's 13 broad categories, e.g. "Restaurants & Cafés", "Beauty & Spa", "Fitness & Sports", "Travel & Hotels". There are no cuisine categories.

category_ids.description: Category ids from discond_list_categories. Use instead of category when you already have ids.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response meta.next_cursor

lat.description: Latitude to search around (with lng). Overrides place.

online_only.description: true: only merchants with online offers (delivery, e-shop).

place.description: Emirate (e.g. Dubai, Abu Dhabi) or a UAE area (e.g. "Dubai Marina", "JBR", "Business Bay", "Yas Island"). Known areas search around the area centre; other areas fall back to their emirate. lat/lng overrides.

provider.description: Provider name e.g. Entertainer, Fazaa, Talabat

provider_ids.description: Provider ids from discond_list_providers. Use instead of provider when you already have ids.

q.description: Merchant name or part of it (matches names only). A bare kind of place such as "spa", "gym" or "dinner" is searched as its category.

sort.description: nearby: closest first (used when a place or lat/lng is given). discover: a mixed list. Chosen automatically from the location.

with_active_offers.description: Only merchants with at least one live offer (default true).

name: discond_find_discounts
title: Find Discond discounts
